jobs.title: Supply Chain & Operations Intern
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. jobs.description: Le Product Management, c’est notre ADN. Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes sur les produits digitaux qui tiennent leur chaîne d’approvisionnement debout. Référencement transporteurs, flux maritimes, routiers et ferroviaires, données critiques, maîtrise des coûts réels. Des sujets denses, peu spectaculaires vus de loin, et parmi les plus structurants qu’un Product Manager puisse porter. Ce que tu fais concrètement : Tu pars du terrain avant de concevoir. Cartographie des flux de données, entretiens avec les coordinateurs transport parfois répartis sur plusieurs pays, identification des vrais irritants. Tu traduis ce qui remonte en parcours cibles, pas en liste de demandes. Tu portes une vision à deux ou trois ans. Tu construis la roadmap d’une plateforme de référencement et de pilotage : automatisation des appels d’offres, gestion des quotas, prévision des délais d’acheminement. Tu décides ce qu’on construit, et ce qu’on laisse tomber. Tu prends la donnée en main. Modèles interconnectés, qualité de la donnée, écarts entre coûts réels transporteurs et refacturation interne. Tu interprètes toi-même les indicateurs, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher. Tu pilotes le cadrage et la delivery. Briefs produit et scénarios d’usage pour ta squad technique, animation des rituels, validation de la conformité à chaque jalon, mise en service et formation des utilisateurs. Un outil historique ne disparaît que si le nouveau tient vraiment la route. Tu mesures l’impact. Réduction de la charge manuelle des équipes transport, fiabilisation des délais, tenue des coûts. Tu définis les KPI et les OKR qui comptent et tu les défends. Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. jobs.description: Position Overview : We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Supply Chain Associate / Import Buyer to join our growing team. The Supply Chain Associate handles communication with global suppliers and assists in the product development cycle. This role is essential in managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, particularly focused on international purchasing, vendor management, and ensuring timely and cost-effective importation of goods. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of global supply chains, procurement practices, and import regulations. Key responsibilities include : Vendor Management: Identify and establish relationships with international suppliers and negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts. Purchasing & Procurement: Manage the procurement of goods from international markets, ensuring the best quality, price, and delivery terms. Order Management: Place and track purchase orders, manage order confirmations, and resolve discrepancies with suppliers. Logistics Coordination: Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of imported goods. Import Documentation: Ensure all required documents (commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, etc.) are accurate and compliant with international and local regulations. Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels and work with internal teams to ensure optimal inventory levels are maintained. Customs Compliance: Ensure adherence to all customs laws, regulations, and import/export guidelines, including tariff classifications and duty calculations. Cost Control: Analyze and manage procurement costs to align with budgetary goals and maximize savings. Vendor Performance Evaluation: Track supplier performance, delivery times, and quality, and work with vendors to improve service. Supply Chain Optimization: Continuously evaluate the supply chain processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs. Risk Managemen
